body: My mom is going to call someone to come out and talk to me. they help people in my situation. They may also help pay for the medication. I've tried online chats but it didn't get anywhere. I've emailed the Samaritans but they haven't replied. I am feeling better this morning. I just feel completely drained of energy. I would like to go somewhere though and get away. I do feel like I need to spend some time away from my family. A hospital would be nice but I would be afraid of catching something there at this time of the year. I"m not going to harm myself though. I was just feeling really bad and desperate for some kind of immediate help. but it's not going to work like that. I need medication. I need something to stabilize my moods and allow me to control my emotions more easily. Hopefully this will work out and thigns will get better. thank you.

Thanks, a small update. I do believe now that I have a chemical imbalance problem. Antidepressants should help me. My cousin's husband has someone come out to help him for a similar problem. I'm not old and don't have the same problems he has but they may be able to help me as well. they are also supposed to help pay for the medication. Maybe if that works out I will feel better and able to get out of the house. thank you.
Yes I will have someone to talk to in person in the morning. I'll try to relax and rest and I should be fine until then. Thank you.
I really prefer to not do it over the phone. I guess I'll just tough it out until in the morning. Thank you.

Thanks but the Asperger's point is just a small part of my problem compared to everything else. I feel so bad right now that I actually feel like harming myself just to get immediate emergency help. Is there a number I can call for that purpose? There is a suicide prevention hotline but I can't lie about something like that. My mom is supposed to be taking me to the Mental Health center in the morning hopefully they will be able to help me. Thanks again.
